title: Hangboard Isometric Repeaters
texts: A repeater style workout designed for climbers building up to body weight hangs - Feet on the ground

A repeater style hangboard workout whilst keeping your feet on the floor. Please make sure to warm up on larger holds before starting this workout.

This is designed to increase strength in your fingers and forearms without needing a pulley and weights for assistance. The stimulus is the same as a repeater workout but more useful for climbers who find body weight hangs close to their max. A repeater set is when you complete several deadhangs in quick succession. 

Choose a comfortable 18-22mm edge for this workout. On each set and rep, hold the edge with both hands using your preferred grip position. Without letting your feet leave the ground, bend your legs to slowly weight the hangboard until it you are applying a challenging force through your fingers. This means you are trying hard to hold on but without reaching a maximum effort. Hold this force for the rep time before relasing your grip shaking out in the short rest period before the next hang. Repeat this several times to complete the set.

You will apply force for 7 seconds on each rep and rest for 3 seconds between reps. Each set consists of 3 reps and there are 4 sets total in this workout. Rest 2 minutes between sets.
